Completed Shadowfang Keep with Tess Reitveld, Grannie Goodness, Vern Wallston, Rel Puresilver, and Sylthara; defeated Rethilgore, Razorclaw, Baron Silverlaine, Springvale, Odo, Fenrus, Nandos and Arugal.

Defeated Targorr, Dextren Ward, Kam Deepfury, Hamhock and Bazil Thredd. Bow at range and lance in close quarters.
Reached level 28 in Darkshire; trained Aimed Shot Rank 2, Arcane Shot Rank 4, Aspect of the Hawk Rank 3, Frost Trap and Mend Pet Rank 3.

Defeated Ghamoo-ra, Geilhast, Lady Sarevess, Twilight Lord Kelris and Aku’mai in Blackfathom Deeps. Obtained the final Corrupted Brain Stem after Aku’mai.
Obtained the Dalaran Sewer Key and reached level 32 in Ironforge. Trained Flare, Raptor Strike Rank 5, Track Demons and Intimidation.
Reached level 33 near Lordamere Lake. Completed two Dalaran runs and earned Defender of Dalaran. Sylthara fell to the Fallen Mages in the second run and was revived.
Player confirmed that Aelindra’s ranged weapon has a bow appearance through transmogrification.
Tamed a scorpid near Magram Village, Desolace, and taught Sylthara Claw Rank 5. Sylthara already knew Bite Rank 5.

Trained Sylthara in Bite and Claw Rank 6 and Dash and Prowl Rank 2. Both fell near Rog’mar at 16:08 Eastern and subsequently recovered.
Turned in Kaijo’s banner and received the Orc Bone Bow for delivering Cornelius’s Rog’mar report. Equipping the bow was not confirmed.

character_continuity: High Order hunter, true name Aelindra Ser'jaen'thal. Blue Gale and Zephyr tattoos and her mother's pearls.
Grouped with Neranduil Zephyrgale for the Cirrusfly Queen and with Merith Gustwing and Evayne Greystorm for Vulgara.
Tamed the young Prideclaw Sylthara in the Shen’dar Highlands at 05:50 Eastern. Later journaled in the Gustberry Lowlands that Sylthara was her best friend.
Escorted Aamelia Windfield during Standing Our Ground and witnessed the orchard’s cyclone construct deal with Ferauu.
Witnessed Elaadrin and Ayessa stand together against Lorthuna at the Rohashi Spires. Ansirem Runeweaver and Muln Earthfury arrived before Rohash withdrew.
Left Zephras Isle by skycutter to Dalaran, then took the one-way portal to Stormwind.

Now knows Edwin VanCleef led the Stonemasons’ Guild and that the masons who rebuilt Stormwind became the Defias Brotherhood. Their reasons and full grievance remain unresolved in her knowledge; preserve this boundary.
Helped with Alba Fairmoon’s investigation into poisoned Westfall water and prepared explosives for the forge beneath Moonbrook.
Read about the War of the Three Hammers at an inn in Stormwind’s Dwarven District.
Searched all day for a Ruins of Lordaeron group without entering it, per Bryan’s account.
Cleared the Ruins of Lordaeron with Egg Eggon, Mia Lichlore, Elkon Norres, Aldrin Stockholm, and Sylthara.
Hired Bram Copperkeep as her Adventurer’s Factor by letter and sent him an enchanted belt.
Swam from Westfall to Booty Bay to avoid the dangers of inland Stranglethorn, then traveled via Ratchet to the Barrens and camped in Desolace with Sylthara.

On November 12, learned that Stormwind’s stonemasons went unpaid and their guild was dissolved. She sympathizes with their demand for wages and questions what the Brotherhood did to Westfall. Delivered VanCleef’s unsent letter to Baros Alexston.
Met Harrend Hardholler while helping in Wetlands; the encounter went badly, but was friendly.
Joined Tess Reitveld, Grannie Goodness, Vern Wallston and Rel Puresilver for Shadowfang Keep; shared humor and survived Arugal but struggled with straggling behind on the way out.
Helped Ranya Sunwisp and Thorsten Steelbeard in Redridge; invited the dwarf along and escorted Corporal Keeshan.

Explored the Wetlands excavation with Archlight Halo, Tikito Malixi, Chuds Maxley, Steverus Jagarius and Hawthorn. Aelindra and Sylthara recovered after the failed Shadetooth pull and a subsequent wipe to Thicket Lurkers on the way out.
Cleared Blackfathom Deeps with Fawney Catspirit, Static Hazards, Rioren Windstep, Timmay Birch and Sylthara. Timmay offered to help find the last brain stem and shared a camp bedroll after the run.
Grouped with Issia Windsinger against the Torn Fin on the Hillsbrad coast and learned her convention for rolling on a shared chest.
Worked with Lionel Lionguard against Kurzen’s fighters. Erik Mcflagon invited her a moment too late for shared Sin’Dall credit, and Aelindra subsequently completed her own hunt.
Explored Gnomeregan with Katherine Cheshire, Caspar Croft, Faye Lorne, John Deathsunder and Sylthara. Thanked Katherine for guiding the group.
Timmay Birch and Poje Hammerstar helped Aelindra bring down Fozruk. Timmay offered to return when she needed help.
Graveyard party included Varreah Echoveil, Vikky Luv, Twinkle Lightspark, and Syndra Dusksworn. Sincerus Argentia joined for Library.
Poje Hammerstar helped with the failed Myzrael summon. Katrana Twilight supplied a second scroll and Stray Wulf joined for the successful attempt. Spoke her true name aloud in Darnassian.

Vissara Veilstrider helped against Kurzen’s special forces. Sho Nuffthamasta, Sol Vancrest and Fabianis Darkwater joined against Colonel Kurzen. Helped Wendel Mathers and gathered supplies alongside Sun House. Both Aelindra and Sylthara fell at Zul’Kunda before Aelindra returned for the fourth legend.
Ended the day at the Elk’s Horn Inn. Her handwritten note says she hopes to return to her bed in Goldshire soon.
November 24: Slopper Plopper, Caster Sy and Seda Lruk helped against Gul’gash; Aelindra valued Sylthara’s safety. Rested at Lion’s Pride Inn in Goldshire.

November 25: adventured with Izriel Lightborn, Lizzy Regina, Damer Flinne, Ellarosa Moonsong, Mylianne Telbrenique, Partypower Hc and guildmate Torbjorn Grymbeard; the latter two helped collect pirate hats.
November 25: ended the day with Sylthara at the inn in Gadgetzan, Tanaris.
November 26 approved story: Aelindra names her Siamese companion Sammie and reflects on the Wildhammer affinity for gryphons and her Skyborne heritage; returns to Goldshire for Thanksgiving.

November 27 approved story: artisan fishing, Friendly with Booty Bay, deathless Razorfen Downs expedition with Deliah Greyholme, Maludos Shadewatcher, Yoggii Bear and Lamia Devlin, level 47 in Riverglades, and return to Goldshire. Sharpbeak remains unresolved.
